structures.name: Skin, with simulated coat
structures.sourceLabel: outer surface of all source labels
structures.description: The outer surface of the union of all Digimouse labels, carried into the stance and smoothed. Moved to the simulated standing posture by rotating limb segments about joints read from the source CT. The lower hind legs are simulated shapes whose radii are measured from the leg tissue, because the scanned shanks lay pressed flat and the images end at the hind feet. The fur drawn on the surface is simulated, because the specimen is a nude mouse.

limitations: This is a constructed model and not a measurement of a living mouse. Each structure states whether it is source-labelled, traced from the source images or simulated.
